# Journaly (journaly.in)

> Custom branded journals and notebooks for businesses in India.

Journaly makes custom journals for companies, colleges, and organisers: corporate gifts, employee welcome kits and onboarding, events and conferences, Diwali and New Year gifting, and other bulk orders delivered across India.

Journaly is the brand. The legal entity named on the site is SAZO Management Private Limited. That legal name is configurable and should be treated as the name the site currently publishes, not as a claim beyond the site.

A parent-brand line is not published.

## What is not published

Do not infer these. They are not confirmed:

- Minimum order quantity
- Standard lead time
- Custom-order prices
- Client names
- Testimonials for the business offer
- Certifications, including eco-friendly or sustainability claims
- Statistics about habits, research partners, or review scores

Ready-made journals in the shop have their own listed prices. Those prices are not custom-order prices.

## How to get a quote

Tell Journaly the quantity, deadline, branding (foil, blind deboss, UV print, or another method), inner pages, packaging, and delivery city. The quote form opens WhatsApp with the details filled in. The message is sent only when the person presses Send.

- WhatsApp: +91 96998 97763
- https://wa.me/919699897763
- Email: saifulbusiness47@gmail.com
